description: Na₆Mo₁₁O₃₆ crystallizes in the monoclinic C2/c space group. There are four inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share  a cornercorner with one MoO₆ octahedra and  an edgeedge with one NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 59°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.35-2.60 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form edge-sharing NaO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.40-2.62 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form edge-sharing NaO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.40-2.47 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent MoO₆ octahedra and edges with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 33°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.37-2.64 Å. There are six inequivalent Mo sites. In the first Mo site, Mo is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Mo-O bond distances ranging from 1.74-2.47 Å. In the second Mo site, Mo is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Mo-O bond distances ranging from 1.74-2.12 Å. In the third Mo site, Mo is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Mo-O bond distances ranging from 1.76-2.32 Å. In the fourth Mo site, Mo is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Mo-O bond distances ranging from 1.74-2.57 Å. In the fifth Mo site, Mo is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Mo-O bond distances ranging from 1.74-2.41 Å. In the sixth Mo site, Mo is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted MoO₆ octahedra that share corners with four NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 33-59°. There are a spread of Mo-O bond distances ranging from 1.74-2.26 Å. There are eighteen inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to three Mo atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Na and one Mo atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Na and one Mo atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a bent 120 degrees geometry to two Mo atoms. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to two equivalent Na and one Mo atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Na and one Mo atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to two Na and one Mo atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one Na and two equivalent Mo atoms. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na and two Mo atoms. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to three Mo atoms. In the eleventh O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na and two Mo atoms. In the twelfth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na and two Mo atoms. In the thirteenth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to three Mo atoms. In the fourteenth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to three Mo atoms. In the fifteenth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na and two Mo atoms. In the sixteenth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to two Na and one Mo atom. In the seventeenth O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one Na and one Mo atom. In the eighteenth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to two Na and one Mo atom.
